::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 28th [1877]  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS Harry Ransom Humanities Research Center, University of Texas, Austin
:::

[Sir](people/person_712.qmd)
<If you had consulted [Mr Keble](people/person_798.qmd)’s [biography](other_books/otherbook_226.qmd) or even the title page of the [Lyra Innocentium](other_books/otherbook_232.qmd) you would have seen that the whole of the poems is by him with one single exception, which is acknowledged.

[The Child’s Christian Year](other_books/otherbook_186.qmd) is a compilation of many different poems by numerous authors

yours truly
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** William Garrett Horder was the compiler of a large number of hymnals from the late 1870s onwards, so that it is hard to identify the particular book referred to in these three letters.  It could however be *The Book of Praise for Children* (1878).
